site.sitedescription: The small shallow Lac du Sommet (0.02 km2, 4 m maximum depth, elevation of 830 m a.s.l., 47°43′N, 70°40′W) is located in the boreal forest north of the St Lawrence Estuary (Figure 1). It is of glacial origin and situated on granitic-gneissic bedrock of the Canadian Precambrian Shield in the Laurentian Mountains.
